title.narrative: the incumbent will contribute to strengthening UNESCO’s political analysis and capacities in an evolving and volatile international environment in particular on specific developments which can have political and operational impact on UNESCO’s action.

description.narrative: Under the guidance and supervision of DIR/CAB, the incumbent will contribute to strengthening UNESCO’s political analysis and capacities in an evolving and volatile international environment in particular on specific developments which can have political and operational impact on UNESCO’s action. The incumbent will also participate in strengthening communication channels with Member States and advising the Director-General and DIR/CAB on potential issues that require political coordination, inlcuding : 1. Liaison with the Sector for Priority Africa and External Relations (PAX), organize and participate in meetings between the Director-General and/or DIR/CAB and the representatives of UNESCO Member States and accompany the Director-General on official visits as required. 2. Work closely with Cabinet’s members in order to anticipate and manage any sensitive political matters related to the implementation of programmes and initiatives. 3. Provides Dir/CAB and the Director-General with political analysis on specific and sensitive matters which can impact the Organization’s activities and governance
